question: For each port status and device owner, show the number of ports and the earliest standard-attribute updated timestamp (only for standard attributes with resource type = 'ports' and excluding ports on shared networks where networkrbacs.action = 'access_as_shared' and target_tenant is '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'), and also include—by port status—the range, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the number of port security bindings per port for ports that have at least one binding and belong to tenant '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.status, p.device_owner, sa.updated_at
  FROM ports p
  JOIN standardattributes sa ON p.standard_attr_id = sa.id
  WHERE sa.resource_type = 'ports'
    AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
      WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
    )
),
grp AS (
  SELECT status, device_owner,
         COUNT(*) AS port_count,
         MIN(updated_at) AS earliest_updated
  FROM base
  GROUP BY status, device_owner
),
port_binding_counts AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.status, COUNT(*) AS binding_count
  FROM ports p
  JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
  WHERE p.tenant_id = '17ea94ad74b64b9d92f4888336a598c7'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.status
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1
),
status_binding_stats AS (
  SELECT status,
         MAX(binding_count) - MIN(binding_count) AS binding_count_range,
         VARIANCE(binding_count) AS binding_count_variance,
         STDDEV(binding_count) AS binding_count_stddev
  FROM port_binding_counts
  GROUP BY status
)
SELECT 
  g.status,
  g.device_owner,
  g.port_count,
  g.earliest_updated,
  sbs.binding_count_range,
  sbs.binding_count_variance,
  sbs.binding_count_stddev
FROM grp g
LEFT JOIN status_binding_stats sbs ON g.status = sbs.status
ORDER BY g.status, g.device_owner;
